verdict.rationale: Meltano is explicitly CLI-first and documented for headless automation: `meltano run` executes pipelines non-interactively, projects support Docker containerization for CI/CD, and docs directly state you can apply 'version control, code review, and continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD)' to a Meltano project. Independent evidence confirms production automated use (GitLab running Meltano in production for scheduled extraction). Missing for 10: a concrete first-party CI config example (e.g. GitHub Actions/GitLab CI yaml) or documented headless-mode flags beyond general CLI/Docker support.
